details.detail: Surface detail: value, panel tone, seams, fastener rows, slat band, gear stripe, placards, grime
details.note: The near skin matches the photo: w17K (300,400) #c3c9d0 L201 and w17A (500,450) L184, against KN41 (300,420) #bbc3d0 L194. The near-far gradient is still reversed, though by less after the exposure change: in w19A the near flap (600,440) is L163 and (560,500) L161, while the far skin (620,250) is L162 and (680,195) L173. The gap is now 10 L (w11: 17). KN41 runs 194 near to 146 far (760,300). The gear-alignment stripe is #1d2127 L33 against KN41 #020815 L9; at window range that is fine. There is no tiling, and the seams and fastener rows are correct.

The layout and gap hierarchy match KN41. In HEAD the near TE gap is still 4 px (w19A row 400, x 561-564, core L38). KN41 shows about 3 px at 1300 wide, which is about 2 px at 930. The taper that fixes this is in the working tree, not in this build.

The A side improved and the K side regressed. A side (w19A): the inboard flank is L100 against the near flap at L163, a ratio of 0.61 (w11: 0.52; KN41: 0.72). It is still one flat tone, a constant L100 over 36 px at x=470 (y 341-374). K side (w26K): the w11 flank bake of 0.92 together with the sun-facing inboard flank (day sun at az -60 lights the -x faces) puts the flank at L187-190, the same as the wing skin at 178-184 (ratio about 1.04). The lit-top step is gone: top 191 over flank 188 at x=600, and the pods read as pale plastic fins. Photos from the same seat show darker flanks: _7331 has the wing at 217 and the flank at 88-111 (0.41-0.51), and _7250 has the top facet at 220-228, the flank at 121-128 and the belly at 73-76. In w11 this view was 217 / 169 / 98. For proportion, the pods look deeper than in the 26K photos: the depth to visible length behind the TE is about 0.33 in w26K, against about 0.22 in _7250 and 0.25 in _7331, though the camera pitch accounts for part of that. The tips are still the faceted near-zero ring, visible in the studio only.
Unchanged in HEAD. The fairing is still slightly small and soft against LALF _137. A fix is pending in the working tree.

issues.detail: canoes: K-side flanks as bright as the wing skin (regression from the w11 flank bake)
issues.problem: HEAD l.445 bakes the vertical flank at 0.92 (it was 0.8 in w10). The day sun (az -60, el 30) strikes the inboard (-x) flanks of the right-wing pods almost normally, and the exterior has no shadow map, so from 26K the pods are a flat pale grey equal to the skin. The lit-top step and the darker flank are gone, and the pods read as white plastic fins. Every 26K photo shows flank/wing at 0.41-0.53, with a bright top facet and a darker belly. The pending working-tree lift only touches +x faces (the A-side inboard flanks), so it leaves this unchanged.
evidence: ref/web/exterior/b_alv_ANA77W_PY_IMG_7331-2-scaled.jpeg (1000 px wide) x=470: wing 217, flank 88-111, belly 72; x=280: top 209-220, flank 96-99
ref/web/exterior/b_alv_ANA77W_PY_IMG_7250-2-scaled.jpeg (1200 px wide) x=150: top 220-228, flank 121-127, belly 73-76; x=400: wing 234, flank 79-128
issues.fix: 11_exterior.js HEAD l.445: drop the base flank back and add a height grade so both sides keep the photo order, e.g. `shadeVerts(B, vC, vN, (p, n) => (0.5 + 0.16 * smooth(-0.9, -0.2, n[1]) + 0.34 * smooth(0.1, 0.45, n[1])) * lerp(0.82, 1.0, smooth(-0.5, -0.05, n[1])))`. That gives a top facet of 1.0, a flank of about 0.66 and a belly of 0.41. Expected: w26K flank about 188 x 0.66 / 0.92 = 135 (0.75 of the skin), with the top step restored. On the A side, carry the flank with the pending +x lift, raised from 1 + 0.4 to about 1 + 0.8 (`f = 1 + 0.8 * smooth(0.15, 0.75, nx) * ...`), so w19A stays near L100-115 (0.61-0.70). The lift is tied to the day sun azimuth; if lighting can raise the exterior ambient on near-vertical normals (04_shaders l.212, amb *= 1 + 0.5 * (1 - abs(N.y)) for u_exterior), use that instead and keep the bake sun-agnostic.

Verify it in the next build against a w11K peak of 185-200 that still shows a roll-off across the cowl. If it still clips, also cut the cowl's upper-half bake (HEAD l.448) from 0.55 + 0.45 * pow((n.y + 1) / 2, 1.6) to 0.5 + 0.42 * pow(...).

issues.problem: The far fixed skin (L162-173) renders as bright as or brighter than the near flap (L161-163); KN41 falls about 25 % from near to far. The vertex ramp at HEAD l.248 is spent. The remainder is the grazing env term, which ignores the baked albedo. Roughness is set per vertex (setVert writes B.m), so the exterior file can ramp it as well.
issues.fix: 11_exterior.js HEAD l.248-255: after the ramp, also ramp the roughness byte outboard, `B.m[k * 4] = Math.round(lerp(0.72, 0.92, clamp((sp - 8) / 14, 0, 1)) * 255)`, for both fixed and movable panels. With Fe = F0 + (max(1 - r, F0) - F0)(1 - NdV)^5 and the (1 - 0.8 r) factor, the grazing env term at s > 22 drops by about 5x (0.118 -> 0.021 x env), which should take the far skin down 15-25 L. The lighting alternative (scale specEnv by the albedo ratio) is listed in w11b.
